title: 第328章 什么叫要挟第327章 竟主动送上门来了
content_zh:
第328章什么叫要挟？
王鸾手腕猛地一偏，掌风擦着纯小白的头皮而过，重重拍在了远处的一座山头上！
轰隆——！
一声巨响，那座数百丈高的山头，竟被她这一掌，硬生生给拍平！
“你！”王鸾气得浑身发抖，胸口剧烈起伏。
纯小白长长地呼出一口气，后背已经被冷汗湿透。
“你妹的，果然还是“兄弟多”好使啊！”
“说！你为何要迫害我万花宗？！”一群女长老也瞬间将他团团围住，一个个怒目而视。
“你究竟是何人！”
“喂喂喂，干嘛干嘛？”纯小白吓得连连后退，摆出一副胆小如鼠的模样。
“我可告诉你们啊，本大王我……我胆子小！要是被你们吓死了，你们都得赔命！”
那些长老闻言，竟真的被他唬住，下意识地后退了一步。
“屁！”王鸾脸色漆黑如锅底，“你小子要是胆小，敢一个人跑到这里，要挟我整个万花宗？！”
“什么叫要挟？”
纯小白一梗脖子，死猪不怕开水烫地嚷嚷道，“是你们自己干了勾结魔头的事，怎么还赖到本大王头上来了？”
“我没有举报你们，你继续看在大家都不容易的份上，说你们，恐怕现在都被帝阁带走了！”
王鸾气的手又扬了扬，心想一巴掌拍死他，突然他想到了什么？
“大王？！”
王鸾上下打量着眼前这个一身黑衣，浑身散发着恶臭的家伙，只能从头套下看到一双贼兮兮的眼睛。
难不成……是哪个山旮旯里跑出来的土匪？

哪来的土匪胆子这么肥？！
但没办法，不管他说的是真是假，眼下的局势，是他一个人拿捏住了他万花宗数万弟子的性命！
他赌不起！
“你小子，到底想怎么样？”王鸾咬着牙，一字一句地从牙缝里挤出这句话。
“本大王其实没想把你们怎么样。”
纯小白摊了摊手，一副受害者的委屈模样，“我就是路过，结果被你们这群疯婆娘撵得满山跑！”
“你们知道我付出了多大的代价吗？我，一个小小筑基境，为了从你们的追杀下活命，硬生生烧掉了价值百亿灵石的丹药！”
“所以，废话不多说，赔我一百亿精神损失费、医药费、误工费！这事儿，咱们就算了了！”
这话一出，在场的一众长老差点当场气炸了肺，一个个面色扭曲。
明明是你这小贼跑来栽赃陷害，如今倒打一耙，竟还说得如此理直气壮、义正辞严！简直是滑天下之大稽！
王澜心中却在飞速盘算，这小子张口就是一百亿，看他那有恃无恐的架势，恐怕……这还只是个开胃菜！
嗖！
就在纯小白准备再加点价码的时候，王澜却极为干脆地从怀里掏出一枚储物戒指，屈指一弹，直接丢了过来。
“这里面是二百亿！把留影石交出来！”
“额！！！”
纯小白下意识地接过戒指，整个人直接傻在了原地。
啥玩意儿？
我要一百亿，你给我二百亿？
本大王……是不是显得有点目光短浅了？
一瞬间，他感觉自己的人格受到了莫大的侮辱！

这就好比一个乡下来的穷小子，跑到亿万富翁家里闹得鸡飞狗跳，最后只为了开口借一块钱！

Chapter 328 What is blackmail?
Wang Luan's wrist jerked away, and the wind from his palm brushed Chun Xiaobai's scalp, and hit a mountain in the distance heavily!
Boom——!
With a loud noise, the mountaintop hundreds of feet high was flattened by her palm!
"You!" Wang Luan was so angry that his whole body was shaking, and his chest was heaving violently.
Chun Xiaobai exhaled a long breath, and his back was soaked with cold sweat.
"As expected of your sister, it's better to have "more brothers"!"
"Say! Why are you persecuting me, the Wanhua Sect?!" A group of female elders immediately surrounded him, glaring at him angrily.
"Who are you!"
"Hey, hey, hey, what are you doing?" Chun Xiaobai was so frightened that he backed away, acting as timid as a mouse.
"Let me tell you, my great king, I...I am cowardly! If I am scared to death by you, you will all have to pay for it!"
When the elders heard this, they were really frightened by him and subconsciously took a step back.
"Shit!" Wang Luan's face was as dark as the bottom of a pot, "If you are a coward, how dare you come here alone and threaten my entire Wanhua Sect?!"
"What is blackmail?"
Chun Xiaobai scratched his neck, and the dead pig was not afraid of the boiling water and shouted, "You yourself did the colluding with the devil, why do you blame this king?"
"I didn't report you. If you continue to think that it's not easy for everyone, I'm afraid you will all be taken away by the Emperor Pavilion now!"
Wang Luan raised his hand in anger again, thinking of slapping him to death. What suddenly occurred to him?
"King?!"
Wang Luan looked up and down at the guy in black clothes who exuded a foul odor, and could only see a pair of sly eyes under his hood.
Could it be...that he was a bandit who escaped from some remote mountain area?
How could a bandit be so brave? !
But there was no way, no matter what he said was true or false, in the current situation, he alone controlled the lives of tens of thousands of disciples of his Wanhua Sect!
He can't afford to gamble!
"You kid, what do you want?" Wang Luan gritted his teeth and squeezed out these words word by word from his teeth.
"This king actually doesn't want to do anything to you."
Chun Xiaobai spread his hands and looked like a victim, "I was just passing by, but you crazy bitches chased me all over the mountain!"
"Do you know how much I paid? I, a small person in the Foundation Establishment realm, burned pills worth tens of billions of spiritual stones in order to survive your pursuit!"
"So, without further ado, pay me 10 billion in mental damages, medical expenses, and lost work wages! Let's forget about this matter!"
As soon as these words came out, all the elders present almost exploded with anger on the spot, and their expressions were distorted.
It's obvious that you, a little thief, came here to frame me, but now you're trying to beat me up, and you still speak so confidently and righteously! It is simply the most ridiculous thing in the world!
Wang Lan was calculating rapidly in his mind. This kid was talking about 10 billion. Looking at his confident attitude, I'm afraid... this is just an appetizer!
Whoosh!
Just when Chun Xiaobai was about to increase the price, Wang Lan took out a storage ring from his arms and threw it directly with a flick of his finger.
"There are 20 billion in this! Hand over the image stone!"
"Uh!!!"
Chun Xiaobai subconsciously took the ring and was stunned on the spot.
What the hell?
I want 10 billion, you give me 20 billion?
This king...doesn't he seem a little short-sighted?
For a moment, he felt that his personality had been greatly insulted!
This is like a poor boy from the countryside who went to a billionaire's house and made a fuss, just to borrow a dollar!
